name: Barlovento
description: Popular café-bar offering generous free tapas with every drink, specialising in fresh fish, rice, and grilled dishes.

name: Taberna Nuevo Torreluz
description: Long-established Plaza Flores tavern serving traditional Almerian ibérico products, salted fish, and tapas in a flamenco-themed setting.

name: Café Indalín
description: Neighbourhood café-bar serving homemade traditional tapas of meat and fish, with a small terrace and a loyal local following.

name: Bar Habibi
description: Classic Almería bar near the Central Market since 1963, beloved for its churros, early-morning breakfasts, and signature meat-with-tomato tapa.

name: Bodega Las Botas
description: Traditional Andalusian bodega on a pedestrian street in the historic centre, offering Iberian meats, cheeses, fresh seafood, and wines by the glass.

name: Bar Quinto Toro
description: Iconic tapas bar open since 1947, famed for patatas a lo pobre with fried egg; a bullfighting-themed institution in the city centre.

name: Cervecería Baviera
description: Seafood cervecería with over 50 years of history near the Paseo de Almería, specialising in fresh fish, shellfish, and traditional rice dishes.

name: Rest. Capitol Centro
description: Mediterranean restaurant with innovative touches set in a renovated historic space at the heart of Almería.

name: San Francisco 26
address: Calle San Francisco de Asís, 26, Almería
description: Family-run bar-restaurant offering creative tapas with a modern twist, plus breakfasts, cocktails, and casual dining.

name: Taberna Nuestra Tierra
description: Cosy tavern in the historic district preparing elaborate Andalusian tapas from local seasonal produce, with vegetarian and gluten-free options.

name: Kiosco 18 Julio
description: Open-air kiosk bar in Plaza Concordia since 1961, celebrated for charcoal-grilled pinchos morunos and traditional draught vermut.

name: Cervecería El Ancla
description: Tapas resto-bar with a broad menu of meat and fish dishes, offering both terrace seating and a private dining room.

name: Scondite
description: Award-winning tapas bar serving carefully sourced classic and creative tapas, renowned for its celebrated bravas potatoes.

name: Bar Peña El Taranto
description: Almería's legendary flamenco cultural club and bar since 1963, housed in medieval cisterns and regularly hosting concerts and recitals.

name: Bar 10-58
description: Highly regarded neighbourhood tapas bar praised by visitors for attentive service and excellent value-for-money tapas.

name: Vintage 54
description: Retro-themed bar-restaurant with an affordable menu of creative tapas including extensive vegan and vegetarian options.

name: Rotterdam Tap Room
description: Craft beer bar featuring 17 rotating taps of national and international craft beers, served alongside complimentary tapas.

name: Tortillería La Mala
description: Eclectic tapas bar specialising in creative Spanish omelettes and fusion tapas, with retro VHS-themed décor.

name: Bar La Vecina
description: Welcoming neighbourhood bar known for generous tapas of near-portion size, with a focus on quality fresh meat.

name: Taberna Rest. La Encina
description: Multi-award-winning tavern in a historic 1860s house near the Alcazaba, serving Mediterranean cuisine with traditional recipes and local products.

name: Bodega Montenegro
description: Family-run bodega near the cathedral since 1949, serving homemade tapas, house vermouth, sangria, and an extensive wine selection.

name: La Bellota & El Buey
description: Gourmet deli-restaurant specialising in acorn-fed Iberian ham, premium beef cuts, and artisan cheeses paired with fine wines.

name: Bar Bahía de Palma
description: Traditional tapas bar offering Spanish bar food for lunch and evening sessions in the historic city centre.

name: Aguamarina
description: Tapas bar on Calle Ricardos occupying the site of the legendary El Alcázar bar, serving traditional Almerian tapas including morcilla, tripe, and ham.

name: Taberna El Andaluz
description: Well-established taberna since 1950, open from breakfast to midnight every day with a vast menu of traditional Spanish tapas and meals.

name: Fausto Vram
description: Popular café-bar near Almería's transport hub, highly rated for quality tapas and Mediterranean home cooking at affordable prices.

name: Bar Las Tiendas
description: Classic tapas bar two minutes from the cathedral, celebrated for its free, freshly cooked fish tapas including clams and daily catches.

name: La Esquinita del Capitol
description: Casual corner bar of the Capitol restaurant group in Plaza Marqués de Heredia, serving informal tapas and drinks in the city centre.

name: La Bambalina
description: Lively tapas bar on one of Almería's busiest bar streets, serving free tapas with drinks and a wide selection of Spanish and Mediterranean dishes.

name: 900 Millas
address: Puerto Pesquero, Calle de Coches, 43, Almería
description: Port cantina in Almería's fishing harbour fusing Cantabrian and Almerian coastal cooking, serving ultra-fresh fish from the daily market catch.

name: La Marítma
description: Striking circular three-storey restaurant in Almería's port with 360° views of the harbour and the Alcazaba, specialising in Mediterranean cuisine.

name: Santa Clara
description: Beachside playa-bar on the Paseo Marítimo at Playa del Zapillo combining classic tapas, artisan coffees, cocktails, and an all-day seafront terrace.

name: El Capo Mangia
description: Italian pizzeria and restaurant on the Paseo Marítimo serving authentic Neapolitan-style pizzas and pasta with views of the Mediterranean.

name: Taberna Todo Locura
description: Neo-tavern offering gourmet pintxos and inventive tapas in a cosy heated terrace setting near the city's auditorium.

name: Freiduría La Barca
description: Seafront freiduría and tapas bar in the Zapillo area, specialising in freshly fried fish and grilled seafood.

name: Terraza Costa
description: Beachfront restaurant with Mediterranean views, renowned for fresh fish, shellfish, gluten-free fry-ups, and lobster paella.

name: Árido Bar
description: Desert-themed bar on the Paseo Marítimo, sister venue to Santa Clara, with a cactus-logo concept celebrating the convergence of land, sky, and sea.

name: Rest. Bar Los Cármenes
description: Multi-storey Mediterranean gastrobar in El Zapillo with an acclaimed corner terrace, known for creative tapas and careful presentation.

name: Taller de Sabores
address: Paraje de la Cepa, 79, Huércal de Almería
description: Wood-fired grill restaurant in Huércal de Almería specialising in Argentine-inspired charcoal-grilled meats, including picanha and house chorizo.

name: Los Barquicos
description: Family Mediterranean restaurant on Carboneras seafront since 1996, famed for red prawns and fish direct from the local fishing market.

name: El Vuelo del Ganso
address: Las Norias de Daza, El Ejido, Almería
description: Gastrobar in Las Norias de Daza, El Ejido, serving premium wood-fired barbecued meats in a welcoming family-friendly atmosphere.

name: La Cosecha
description: Restaurant and bar inside the Gran Hotel Victoria on El Ejido's main boulevard, serving Spanish and Mediterranean cuisine with locally grown vegetables.

name: Neptuno Mojácar
description: Award-winning seafront restaurant on Mojácar's Mediterranean promenade, specialising in paellas, fresh daily-catch fish, and grilled octopus.
